mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees and partly cloudy near the Verona Public Library under a Waning Crescent moon. The overnight low will drop to 48 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community feedback, outlines how the city will prioritize sustainable housing, downtown development, and infrastructure over the next ten years.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Tomorrow, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy ART House 360 events, or join Hop Haus Trivia. Then, on Friday, check out live music at Bailey's Run or Paddy Mac's, and don't miss the Puppets in the Park festival at Century School Park.

Regarding recent activity, on September 28, a 16-year-old was cited for multiple offences including reckless driving and operating a motorcycle without a license after an incident involving an eMoto on East Verona Avenue.

The Culver's flavor of the day, Turtle Cheesecake, is no longer available as the store is closed for the night. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10:00 AM when we will be serving up Double Strawberry.
